scope: Proposed shared TS/Rust matching corpus for palette promotion; executed against apps/fractal-web/src/command-palette/match.ts

rules.query: trim, lowercase, split whitespace into independent tokens; every token must match at least one searched field
rules.token: best tier wins: prefix (token starts a word) > initials (token letters start consecutive words from the field start) > substring (token inside a word)
rules.render: highlight a token only in fields that reach its best tier; highlights are contiguous runs or word initials, never letters scattered within a word
rules.rank: matching urgent agents pinned first; then score (word-prefix matches outrank initials and substrings; earlier fields break ties); unqueried agents MRU-first; retain agent-to-session ownership

cases.explanation: both tokens start words in the agent name; de also starts folder and host words
ui starts a word in agent and session; de only in host, which must be highlighted
u…i would only be letters of later words; scattered letters are not a match
initials must start at the field start; u and i of later words do not match
interior substring is the lowest tier and stays contiguous
word-prefix occurrences win over the interior de in Code
host-only match; the row shows the disabled offline reason
initial letters of consecutive words from the field start
scattered interior letters are not a match
empty query preserves urgency/MRU ordering; no highlighting

ranking.explanation: a word-prefix match in the agent name outranks an interior substring
a word-prefix match outranks an interior substring
